lines: Russo-Ukrainian War Crimea attacks The Crimean Bridge is struck by a Ukrainian kamikaze drone, damaging the structure and prompting Russian authorities to close vehicle traffic. The bridge is partially reopened later in the day. (The Guardian)(BBC)
2026 Iran War Iran-United States relations Reported intel that Iran is developing plans to potentially detonate a Dirty bomb in Washington.

Yemeni civil war 2026 Yemen offensives Saudi Arabia's King Salman appoints Fayyadh Al Ruwaili as commander of the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen, following the retreat of Yemeni government forces from areas near the Bab al-Mandeb to Aden. (Al Jazeera)
Crime in South Africa Nine people are killed in a mass shooting at a shack near Pretoria, South Africa. (NBC News)
Eight people are found shot and killed inside a vehicle in Sweetwaters, South Africa. (AP)
Mexican drug war Five gunmen are killed after a shootout between criminal organizations in Chignahuapan, Puebla, Mexico.(El Sol de México)
Two people are killed and three more injured in a mass shooting at party in Mazatlán, Sinaloa, Mexico.(El Universal)

The European Commission (EC) and the United States Federal Reserve approve Italian bank UniCredit's proposed €45 billion (US$49 billion) acquisition of Germany's Commerzbank, following the European Central Bank's approval in October. The EC grants unconditional antitrust clearance. (Reuters)
2026 Patong fire Eleven people are killed and 16 others are injured in a fire at a four-story building in Patong, Phuket province, Thailand. (Al Jazeera)

Somalia–United States relations, USAID in the second Trump administration, United States intervention in Somalia The United States Agency for International Development reverses its decision to withdraw funding from the United Nations Support Office for Somalia and supports extending its mandate and that of the African Union's military mission combating Al-Shabaab for another year. (AFP)

2026 Paraguay banking crisis A Paraguayan judge orders impeached former president Santiago Peña transferred to the Viñas Cué military prison pending trial on charges of criminal association, breach of trust, and misuse of public office linked to Ueno Bank's collapse. (Reuters)
Insurgency in Bahrain Bahrain sentences 64 Shia Muslims, mostly clerics, to life in prison for establishing a terrorist group linked to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. (BBC)

2026 Gambian presidential election The Gambian election commission approves President Adama Barrow's candidacy for a third term in the December 5 presidential election as the country's constitution does not limit presidential terms. (Reuters)
